Case reference: 2013000025.CaseDesc: Darwin Sylvester was last seen at approximately 11 p.m. on May 28, 1998, in Brandon, Manitoba. He contacted his partner shortly after 12:00 a.m. on May 29th to inform her of his intention to meet with an associate for breakfast; however, he failed to attend the meeting. All of his personal belongings and luggage were located at a residence on Chalmers Road. We have not been able to establish any contact with Darwin since that time.

Tattoo: Left Arm, "Spartans MC in Memory of" (text)

Case reference: 2006008799.CaseDesc: Doris Fennell was last observed at the home of an acquaintace in Kitley-Elizabeth Township, near Addison, Ontario. Foul Play is strongly suspected in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014034912.CaseDesc: Norman Playter was last seen on May 4, 2014 in the hamlet of Grasswoods Park, south of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan.  An investigation was conducted into his disappearance, which resulted in one person being charged. Although the investigation revealed who was responsible for his death, Norman's remains have not been located.

Case reference: 2014001506.CaseDesc: During the early morning hours of February 24, 1991, Harrison Brown left a friend's home on snowmobile and was last seen traveling near open water.

Hat: Plastic, Black, Snowmobile helmet with red and gold stripes
Scar: Left Upper Arm, Just above elbow

Case reference: 2014002754.CaseDesc: Charles Williams was last seen on coastal waters offshore from Cartwright, Newfoundland & Labrador on November 3rd, 1963.  Charles was operating a 12 foot outboard motorboat and did not return home.

Case reference: 2018069999.CaseDesc: Jordan Nahachick, from the Simon Lake, Alberta area, was reported missing to police on December 21, 2018 and was last seen leaving Peace River Hospital in the afternoon hours of December 10, 2018. Police and his family are continuing their efforts to locate Jordan out of concern for his safety and well-being.

Case reference: 2014005016.CaseDesc: On October 21, 2007, Jason Adam was seen for the last time near the Shaw Conference Center in Edmonton, Alberta. Jason left a family member’s residence on foot to meet with an ex-girlfriend for coffee. On the previous day, Jason had traveled from Lac La Biche, Alberta to Edmonton to attend a guardianship court hearing on October 22, 2007, but he never showed up.

Case reference: 2020040348.CaseDesc: Muriel Jones was seen for the last time in 1959 in Toronto, Ontario. Muriel had indicated that she was intending on traveling to the West.

Case reference: 2014002565.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1975, Carl Gallen was employed as a steelworker on the Long Spruce Dam project. He and his partner were working on a cement wall near the river. Carl was drilling into the wall when he fell into the water. His partner stated that he went directly under the water and did not see him surface. Carl wasn't wearing a harness or lifejacket. It's presumed he drowned.

Case reference: 2019040153.CaseDesc: On July 4, 2019, Shae-Lynn McAllister was seen for the last time at 10:30 pm leaving work at the A&W restaurant in Fairview, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006019099.CaseDesc: Janet Derbyshire was last seen on December 4, 1976, in St. Joseph Island near Sault Ste. Marie, ON.  She was seen jumping off the St. Joseph's Island Bridge into the water. She was seen floating downstream for approximately .25 miles (400 m) before she submerged under water. Janet is presumed drowned but her body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2019068219.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2019, Marshal Iwaasa was last seen by his family in Lethbridge, Alberta. During this time, Marshal had told his family that he was returning to Calgary, Alberta. On November 23, his burnt vehicle was recovered at the end of Phelix Creek Forest Service Road, in a remote area near the Birkenhead Lake Provincial Park in British Columbia.

Case reference: 2013000098.CaseDesc: On September 5, 1974, eight men were on a drilling barge. As they were making no headway against a strong current, it was agreed upon to park the barge for the night. The eight men worked together to park the vessel however one of the legs failed to lower, causing the barge to tip. Donald Bradburn was amongst the men who were thrown from the barge. Despite dragging operations Donald has never been located.

Case reference: 2014002244.CaseDesc: On August 11, 2000, Giuseppe Ciancio was seen for the last time at the Beaches Pub in the Saint-Laurent District of Montreal, Quebec. On that evening, Giuseppe left the bar with a friend in a beige Dodge Caravan. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2025070913.CaseDesc: On December 28, 2025, Brian Sicard was reported missing by his family to the Chilliwack RCMP in British Columbia. We have not had any communication or sighting of Brian since December 26, 2025. It has been confirmed that Brian drives a brown 2006 Chevrolet Cobalt, which is also currently missing. Despite exhaustive efforts, neither Brian nor his vehicle have been located, and there have been no confirmed sightings.

Case reference: 2018000902.CaseDesc: Daniel Harvey was seen for the last time on December 28, 2017 in the Bellerive district of Montreal, Quebec. None of Daniel's personal items were missing from his apartment.

Case reference: 2014002868.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1989, Ronald Jack last spoke with his mother. During that telephone discussion, Ronald had informed her that he and his wife, Doreen Jack, would be leaving for a “camp job”. He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2020008580.CaseDesc: On December 14, 1973, at approximately 8:30 am, Teresa Desa was seen for the last time at her family home in Toronto, Ontario. There is a possibility that Teresa ran away with the family’s tenant, Amavel Santos.

Coat: Brown, Light brown with white trim

Case reference: 2014006426.CaseDesc: Sara Coates was last seen on August 1, 2013 in the Stanley Park area in Calgary, Alberta.  Sara led a nomadic lifestyle, travelling with her dog and three cats throughout Alberta and British Columbia in her van. On October 22, 2013, her van was found in a secluded area of Mînî Thnî (Morley) First Nations settlement, Alberta. It appeared to have been there for some time. Police investigations into Sara's whereabouts are ongoing.

Scar: 2 small surgical scars on inner groin

Case reference: 2014005786.CaseDesc: Giuseppe Renda was last seen on May 4, 2012, at approximately 12:30 p.m., on Saint-Viateur Street West in the Plateau Mont-Royal borough of Montreal, Quebec. Giuseppe lived in the Westmount District, and was a discreet man who did not leave his home often.

Case reference: 2008245047.CaseDesc: Jadon may be in the company of his non-custodial mother Roxana Eliana Yanez Parada.

Case reference: 2013000096.CaseDesc: On May 6,  1972, a team of four men who were fishing and trapping resumed their journey, on dog sleds after purchasing supplies from Lynn Lake, Manitoba. Russell Bonner and his colleague were leading on Barrington Lake. The second team came upon their sled, broken through the ice. Upon arrival at the scene, both parties were found to be submerged. One of the men was pulled from the water but could not be revived. Russell never resurfaced and despite dragging operations he could not be located.

Case reference: 2026007466.CaseDesc: On April 3, 1994 Heidi Allen was last seen at the D & W Convenience Store located at the intersection of State Routes 104 and 104B in Oswego County, Town of New Haven, New York, USA.  Heidi’s personal belongings were left behind and her vehicle was abandoned in the parking lot.

Glasses: Wears either glasses or contact lenses
Jewelry: Gold, 18" gold chain with a heart and diamond charm
Sweater: Grey, Sweatshirt, Plaid pattern with "SU" Logo on the front

Case reference: 2014043144.CaseDesc: On August 3, 2014, Aaron Dragonetti was seen for the last time in the downtown area of St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador.

Case reference: 2022040012.CaseDesc: On August 10, 2022, Joseph Aldonia Chiasson was seen for the last time by his loved ones in the Shippagan region of New Brunswick. There have been unconfirmed reports that Joseph was seen in the Lamèque, New Brunswick area on August 12, 2022.

Case reference: 2014001441.CaseDesc: On April 28, 1972, James Cordell was seen for the last time leaving his parents’ residence in St. Catharines, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, James was driving a 1970 silver blue Dodge Polar vehicle.  He had a cast on his right arm and his teeth were wired shut as a result of a motor vehicle collision.

Shirt: Purple, Lavender, Mauve, White, SHRT SLEEV, Mauve and white terrycloth short sleeve

Case reference: 2013000013.CaseDesc: On April 27, 1967, at approximately 4:00 p.m., Marianne Schuett was seen for the last time in the vicinity of the Kilbride Public School's driveway in North Burlington, Ontario. During the time of her disappearance, Marianne was seen talking to an unknown man in a vehicle, and it is believed that she was abducted by this man.

Hair: Brown, Bangs in front, ear length at back

Case reference: 2018041855.CaseDesc: On December 8, 1992, Grayce Baxter was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. She was a known transgendered sex trade worker. She had a transaction with Patrick Johnson who subsequently confessed to her homicide. Grayce’s remains were never recovered.

Coat: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Fur, Full length coat

Case reference: 2014004353.CaseDesc: George Turnbull was last seen in Makinak, Manitoba, on June 22, 2002, at approximately 8 p.m., as reported by a home care worker. He was last spoken to on the phone by his son at around 10 pm that same day. Searches of the area around his residence and farmyard was initiated by his family and volunteers. George suffers from mild dementia and has previously wandered off.

Case reference: 2016047824.CaseDesc: On August 18, 2016, Marie-Claude Hebert was last seen leaving her residence, on foot, on St-Calixte Street in Plessisville, Quebec. She has not been seen since.

Sweater: Cotton, Black, Unknown logo on the front

Case reference: 2013000085.CaseDesc: On April 17, 1994, Jose Fernandez was seen for the last time at his residence in the Villeray neighbourhood in Montreal, Quebec. Following a disagreement, Jose left home in his car, a red 4-door Mercury Capri, without saying where he was going.

Case reference: 2016026140.CaseDesc: Amber Wilson was last seen at 9:30pm on May 15, 2016, in Edmonton's downtown area. Amber has medical issues, and she is dependent on her medication. Amber lives a high risk lifestyle, and it is out of character for her not to be in contact with her family. Her family is extremely concerned for her welfare.

Case reference: 2016060399.CaseDesc: On October 3, 1975, the skeletal remains of a male were found in the brush on Sparrow Lake Road (Lot 23 Con 14) in Orillia. His post-mortem length was recorded as being between 5'8"-5'9" however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  A pair of nail clippers was also found nearby. His death is estimated to have occurred in the spring or summer prior.

Teeth: No dental work, missing a few teeth in upper jaw.
Scarf: Orange, Knitted gold-coloured material, possibly a scarf or sweater
Shoes: Brown leather clog-type shoes with a raised Cuban heel, size 7-8
Tie: Red, white, and blue material with curved design - possibly a necktie or head band
Underwear: White, Undershirt with label, partial initials "MP" followed by "LAN", beneath these "PETTIN"

Case reference: 2014001088.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1973, the remains of an adult male were recovered from the Whirlpool of the Niagara River, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 165lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His eye colour is believed to be brown. He was recovered without clothing.

Ring: Silver ring with a green stone on the third finger of his right hand
Watch: Cloth, Left wrist, had a red, yellow and blue watchstrap.

Case reference: 2014004496.CaseDesc: Peter Cortner was last seen on May 20, 2004. He was reported missing by his apartment manager where he resided in Downtown Vancouver. He had left all his belongings behind in his apartment suite and disappeared without notice.

Case reference: 2019081061.CaseDesc: Robert Nauman was last seen in Toronto, Ontario in 2007.  His family is of the opinion that he may have travelled to Costa Rica.

Case reference: 2013000077.CaseDesc: On October 10, 1986, Michael Semergian was seen for the last time in the Outremont District in Montreal, Quebec. Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001642.CaseDesc: In October 1983, Edna Smith was last seen at a camp with two other persons on East Trout Lake, located approximately 120 kilometres north of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. A search operation successfully located the bodies of her two companions, but she herself remained unaccounted for. The boat that had been used by the three individuals was discovered capsized in the lake. It is suspected that all three individuals drowned.

Deformity: Mouth, Cleft Palate had been operated on

Case reference: 2014005195.CaseDesc: Tommy Charpentier worked on a farm and lived with his employer in Sainte-Brigitte-des-Saults, Quebec. On the night of December 15, 2008, tracks in the snow indicate that Tommy may have walked on the Nicolet River that passes in front of the farm. Tommy’s clothes were found on the frozen surface of the river, near an opening in the ice. This suggests that Tommy may have jumped into the icy waters of the Nicolet River.

Scar: Ears, Right ear piercing without earring
Chest, Left nipple piercing without a ring

Case reference: 2005002499.CaseDesc: On March 23, 1987, a black male was found on the shoreline of the Holly Bay Lodge (Lot 8, Con. 12, Dover Township) in Mitchell's Bay of Lake St. Clair, Wallaceburg. He may have been a smoker. He is believed to have been dead for approximately 8 months.

Money: coins, most recent 1985, distributed after March
Shoes: Blue, Grey, running shoes "Winner" brand, size 8 with velcro fasteners
Socks: Cotton, White, red and blue stripes at the top
Other: May have suffered from lower back pain

Case reference: 2009004899.CaseDesc: Sacha Latulippe left Montreal Airport for Mexico city on October 15, 2009. He advised his family he was leaving for business. Investigation revealed he had 2 wives in different towns and was leading a “double life”. He left with his business partner Eric Marcel on this same flight. Eric is also missing.

Hair: Blonde, Brush Cut, Spikey/gelled, natural brown; Sideburns

Case reference: 2020015970.CaseDesc: On August 31, 2017, John Spratt was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. John is known to be homeless, and has been diagnosed with some serious health issues. John would always check in with his family every couple of years, however, they have not heard from him since 2017.

Case reference: 2014001632.CaseDesc: Elizabeth Dorion was last seen by a friend at a local fishing camp in Pukatawagan, Manitoba on September 21, 1999. She arrived at the fishing camp on September 17th with her friends and stayed there for approximately 4 days. She was never seen again. Searches of the area, including several steep embankments and the immediate vicinity of the camp, yielded no significant findings. Elizabeth's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2007002799.CaseDesc: Amanda Rudge was last seen by her mother at her residence on Enfield Place, Mississauga in August of 1991. At the time she went missing, Amanda was known to frequent the Bloor and Landsdowne area of Toronto. Amanda may have connections to the United States.

Hair: Auburn, Other, Natural Auburn dyed Blonde
Teeth: Broken Front Tooth which had been fixed
Pierce: Ears, Several piercings in both ears
Tattoo: Left Foot, APBT letters on her left toes

Case reference: 2013000023.CaseDesc: Marilyn Ann Hersey was last seen on January 28, 2006, outside the Abbie J. Lane Memorial Building on Veterans Memorial Lane in Halifax, Nova Scotia.  Marilyn was due to return to the hospital but never did and was not seen again.  Marilyn needs to take daily medications to treat numerous ailments which she did not take with her after leaving the hospital.

Hair: Blonde, Grey, Wavy blonde and greying hair

Case reference: 2018029665.CaseDesc:
On May 29, 2018, at approximately 12:40 p.m., Vernon Otto last spoke with his wife
over the telephone, as he was on their property in St. Clements, Manitoba. During the
course of their conversation, Vernon had told his wife that he was going to speak with
a neighbour about vehicle ramps he had lent to him. Vernon had also told her that he
was going to go the Interlake area to look at farm machinery, specifically a crawler.
Vernon's truck was found burnt on May 30th, 2018, at 5:20 pm, a few miles from his
residence.

Case reference: 2014001859.CaseDesc: On August 19, 1997, Wendy Ratte was reported missing by her daughter. Wendy was last seen on August 18, at 3pm. Her vehicle was found, locked, in a grocery store parking lot. Investigations led to a conviction in 2010, however her remains have yet to be located.

Case reference: 2014005006.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2007, Sun Jin, her husband Joon Han, and their daughter Il Han were seen for the last time at a school in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014003679.CaseDesc: In December 1983, Konrad Murach was last seen by his family. Since this time, Konrad has not been seen nor has anyone heard from him.

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2006010399.CaseDesc: William Halverson was last seen getting into a canoe at Bald Indian Bay in Lake of the Woods. He failed to arrive at his destination of Pine Portage Bay.

Case reference: 2014005571.CaseDesc: On March 18, 2011, Isabelle Roy-Roland left the Hotel Dieu Hospital of Lévis, in Levis, Quebec after receiving permission to leave the grounds. Isabelle was never seen again.

Coat: Brown, 3/4 length coat with fur on the hood

Case reference: 2014003100.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1995, Jacob Sallenback was seen for the last time at his residence in Calgary, AB.

Shirt: Other, TEE, Kings Crew logo, Aqua
